title: Remove stray .gitkeep placeholder files from non-empty lib/ directories
why: .gitkeep files exist only to make git track an otherwise-empty directory. lib/core/constants/ has held 3 real source files this whole time, so this .gitkeep serves no purpose. An informal repo-wide grep (context only, not a full audit) found the same stale pattern in roughly 103 other lib/ directories, e.g. core/database/daos/.gitkeep sitting alongside 48 real files — almost certainly leftover from an initial scaffold generator never cleaned up once real files landed. Zero functional risk; it's noise in `git status`/`find` output and a minor signal that scaffold cleanup isn't part of the standard workflow.
recommendation: Delete .gitkeep from any lib/ directory that already contains another tracked file; keep it only where a directory is genuinely still empty.
acceptance_criteria: A `make audit` (or pre-commit) check flags any .gitkeep whose directory contains another tracked file
